WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900),
a AS (SELECT sale_date, store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, SUM(net_amount) n FROM f WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, receipts, net_sales_before_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900)
SELECT COUNT(*) rows_cmp, SUM(CASE WHEN a.r IS DISTINCT FROM b.receipts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rec_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(a.n,0)-coalesce(b.net_sales_before_returns,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) net_diff, SUM(a.n) mine, SUM(b.net_sales_before_returns) rpt, SUM(a.r) myr, SUM(b.receipts) rptr
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.sale_date=b.business_date AND a.store_id=b.store_id

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_company,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id<900 THEN l.net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id<900 THEN l.receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_stores,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id=900 THEN l.net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id=900 THEN l.receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_web,
       SUM(l.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) receipts
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
      AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv_company,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_stores,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_web,
       SUM(net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN receipt_id END) web_receipts
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
